feeds.title: San Francisco Senior Beat Blog
feeds.description: SeniorBeat is an online magazine whose goal is to share the lives of San Francisco's older adults in all their diversity. Our stories relate their experiences and wisdom as well as challenges and opportunities in later life. In ways small and large, they have all contributed to the community life of this world-famous city. SeniorBeat is an initiative of the San Francisco Community Living Campaign. Our writers are from its SF ReServe program. We aspire to a society in which people of all ages see, hear, and benefit from one another. Robin Evans, Editor

feeds.title: Better Health While Aging
feeds.description: Dr. Leslie Kernisan shares practical information to help you address problems that often keep aging adults from enjoying better health, well-being, and independence. BetterHealthWhileAging.net is a mission-driven health and caregiving information site that provides practical, actionable information for older adults and family caregivers.

feeds.title: DailyCaring
feeds.description: When you're struggling to care for an older adult (and stay sane), you need practical answers fast. We help you solve the frustrating day-to-day problems that make you lose your temper or keep you up at night. Caring for seniors doesn't have to be this hard. Make it easier with free, practical tips that solve everyday challenges. We help you Discover, Know, and Do

feeds.title: Jewish Home And Senior Living Foundation Blog
feeds.description: The Jewish Home & Senior Living Foundation was established in 2004 as a charitable foundation to promote and support the provision of Jewish aging services, including the mission and activities associated with San Francisco Campus for Jewish Living and network affiliates. As the fundraising arm of SFCJL, the Foundation helps provide crucial funding for programs and services for older adults living in our community.
